hero.title: Study International Business in Switzerland
hero.subtitle: Switzerland is a magnet for students who want to study global trade, international management, finance and cross-border business operations. Students studying International Business in Switzerland are trained to gain skills in international finance, global marketing, business strategy, negotiation and intercultural communication. The country’s international business environment exposes you to multinational companies, financial institutions, consulting firms and global supply chain. Students can opt for undergraduate or postgraduate programs based on their academic qualifications and career objectives.

faq.question: Is IELTS or TOEFL mandatory for studying International Business in Switzerland?
faq.answer: Requirements vary by institution and program level. English-taught programs generally require IELTS (6.5+) or TOEFL (90+), while German/French programs require proof of proficiency at B2/C1 levels.

faq.question: Can Indian students work part-time while studying International Business in Switzerland?
faq.answer: Yes, international students are permitted to work up to 15 hours per week during academic semesters and full-time during official vacation periods after completing 6 months of study in Switzerland.

faq.question: What is the average tuition fee for International Business in Swiss public universities?
faq.answer: Public universities in Switzerland offer highly subsidized tuition, typically ranging from CHF 1,000 to CHF 4,000 per year, making it one of the most cost-effective study destinations in Europe.

faq.question: Are degrees from Swiss universities recognized globally and in India?
faq.answer: Yes, degrees awarded by Swiss cantonal and federal universities are accredited by the Swiss government and recognized globally, including by the Association of Indian Universities (AIU) and international employers.
